headline: 🔥 F5 BIG-IP APM zero-day exploited, 🛡️ Check Point management RCE in the wild, 🌐 VeloCloud CVSS 10 KEV add, 🇨🇳 GreyNoise names Zyxel switch actor, 🤖 CLOSEDQUORUM AI-deciding malware, 🏛️ Florida DMV breach confirmed
summary: Three actively exploited vendor-console flaws (F5 BIG-IP APM zero-day, Check Point management RCE, VeloCloud CVSS 10) landed in one KEV batch, GreyNoise tied the Zyxel GS1900 switch exploitation to a Chinese actor harvesting 996 devices, and Talos documented CLOSEDQUORUM, the first Windows implant that asks commercial AI models to pick its next action.

overrides.why: Outside the hot slate at score 3.2, but the read-through of the analysis and event shows a critical CVE-2026-94545 RCE patched today in a ubiquitous framework; worth a line before scanning waves start.
Used as the connective frame for the F5/Check Point/VeloCloud trio read from its analysis; one KEV batch naming three exploited vendor consoles is the day's pattern story.
Promoted to lead over the KEV batch: analysis confirms an in-the-wild unauthenticated zero-day RCE with 14,700+ exposed hosts, the day's defining development dated 2026-09-23.
Kept but closed near the end: analysis offers no CVE or TTP beyond the victim, so it ranks below the exploit and disruption stories despite a 3.9 score.
Analysis shows the case is Ryuk initial-access sentencing from 2019-2020 attacks, not Conti; enforcement-news value only, so kept mid-pack and framed accurately.
